name: H. F. Fountain
bio: H. F. Fountain kept a store at Mingusville in 1886. The paper praised his stock of goods in April 1886.

moments.label: Praised for his store's assortment at Mingusville

mentions: H. F. Fountain of Mingusville sells J. S. Collins & Co's. saddles and saddlery extras at catalogue prices.
H. F. Fountain has in his store at Mingusville as fine an assortment of goods as we have seen on the line of the Northern Pacific.
H. F. Fountain of Mingusville sells J. S. Collins & Co's. saddles and saddlery extras at catalogue prices.
